## 6. Interface Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Dashboard

requirementTraceRows.title: Recently Completed Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display recently completed work items, including completed issues, tasks, merged pull requests, or backend-equivalent work records where available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Active Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display currently active work items grouped by project, sprint, epic, status, or priority.

requirementTraceRows.title: Upcoming Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display upcoming work items based on Airframe Core-provided priority, sprint, epic, backlog, or readiness information.

requirementTraceRows.title: Blocked Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display blocked work items and associated blocked reasons where available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Ready for Human Verification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display work items that have been marked ready for human verification by an authorized actor.

requirementTraceRows.title: Verification Review
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to review verification evidence associated with a work item.

requirementTraceRows.title: Accept Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to accept completed work only after Airframe Core determines the operation is allowed by actor authority and workflow state.

requirementTraceRows.title: Reject Work
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow an authorized human actor to reject work and return it to an appropriate workflow state with a required reason or comment.

requirementTraceRows.title: Sprint Control
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow authorized human actors to open and close sprints, subject to Airframe Core workflow validation.

requirementTraceRows.title: Epic Control
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall allow authorized human actors to open and close epics, subject to Airframe Core workflow validation.

requirementTraceRows.title: Issue / Task Review
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall display issues and tasks using canonical Airframe Core entity data independent of backend-specific storage.

requirementTraceRows.title: Metrics Display
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Agile Cockpit shall display Airframe Core-provided metrics including, at minimum:

- Sprint progress.
- Burndown.
- Velocity.
- Blocked work count.
- Recently completed work count.
- Work ready for verification.
- Aging of verification items.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Visibility
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall provide access to audit events associated with project-management actions, including allowed and denied operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Multi-Project View
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall support viewing multiple projects in a consolidated dashboard.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project-Specific View
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall support drilling into a single project for detailed review.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend-Agnostic Operation Display
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall present operations and entities using Airframe Core domain terms rather than backend-specific terminology where practical.

requirementTraceRows.title: Denied Operation Reporting
requirementTraceRows.statement:
When Airframe Core denies an operation, Agile Cockpit shall display the denial reason in human-readable form.

## 7. Non-Functional Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Usability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall prioritize one- or two-click access to current status, recently completed work, active work, upcoming work, blocked work, and verification queues.

requirementTraceRows.title: Accessibility
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall be designed with accessibility as a primary concern.

requirementTraceRows.title: Performance
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall load dashboard summaries for configured projects without requiring full backend ingestion during routine use, where cached or summarized data is available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Reliability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall clearly report stale data, backend failures, authorization failures, and synchronization errors.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Independence
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall not hard-code assumptions specific to GitHub or any other backend provider.

requirementTraceRows.title: Maintainability

## 8. Verification Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Certified Actor Identity
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall rely on Airframe Core to certify actor identity and actor type before any write operation is requested.

requirementTraceRows.title: No Self-Declared Authority

requirementTraceRows.title: Human-Only Operations
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall expose human-only operations only to authenticated and authorized human actor types as determined by Airframe Core.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Context Binding
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall include project context in all operation requests. Airframe Core shall determine whether the actor may operate on the target project.

requirementTraceRows.title: Sensitive Operation Confirmation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Agile Cockpit shall require explicit human confirmation before requesting sensitive operations such as closing a sprint, closing an epic, bulk status changes, or configuration changes.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Event Generation
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Agile Cockpit write operations shall result in Airframe Core-generated audit events.

## 6. Interface Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Canonical Project Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define canonical representations for projects, repositories, epics, sprints, issues, tasks, verification gates, evidence, actors, credentials, authority classes, workflow states, metrics, backend references, and audit events.

requirementTraceRows.title: Actor Identity Certification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall certify actor identity from trusted credential context, session information, or configured identity providers.

requirementTraceRows.title: Actor Type Certification
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall derive actor type or authority class from certified identity and policy. Airframe Core shall not accept actor type as a trusted caller-provided assertion.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Context Binding
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall bind each operation to an execution project and target project and shall enforce project-scope rules.

requirementTraceRows.title: Project Scope Mismatch Denial
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall deny mutation operations when execution project and target project do not match and no explicit cross-project delegation exists.

requirementTraceRows.title: Authority Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define and enforce operation permissions by actor type, project context, target entity, credential scope, and workflow state.

requirementTraceRows.title: Workflow State Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define workflow states for project entities and shall validate all requested state transitions.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human-Only Gates
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall enforce human-only gates for accepting work, closing work, opening or closing sprints, opening or closing epics, approving architecture decisions, and changing workflow policies.

requirementTraceRows.title: LLM-Allowed Operations
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support LLM-allowed operations including proposing issues, proposing tasks, attaching evidence, and marking work ready for human verification.

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Creation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support creation of canonical project entities subject to authority and workflow constraints.

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Update
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support updates to canonical project entities subject to authority and workflow constraints.

requirementTraceRows.title: Entity Query
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support queries for projects, epics, sprints, issues, tasks, evidence, verification gates, metrics, and audit events.

requirementTraceRows.title: Sprint Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall model sprints, including status, date range, contained work, progress, completion state, and closure criteria.

requirementTraceRows.title: Epic Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall model epics, including contained work, progress, status, and closure criteria.

requirementTraceRows.title: Verification Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall model verification gates, evidence records, acceptance criteria, and human verification outcomes.

requirementTraceRows.title: Task Packet Generation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall generate compact task packets for AI Cockpit containing only relevant task context, constraints, acceptance criteria, verification commands, protected paths, and required reporting information.

requirementTraceRows.title: Metrics Computation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall compute project metrics including sprint progress, burndown, velocity, blocked work, recently completed work, upcoming work, active work, and verification aging.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Event Generation
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall generate audit events for allowed and denied write operations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Adapter Interface
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall define backend adapter interfaces for reading and writing canonical entities to external backends.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Capability Model
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall support a capability model describing what each backend adapter can and cannot represent natively.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backend Mapping
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core shall map canonical entities and operations to backend-specific representations through adapters.

requirementTraceRows.title: Local Cache
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe Core may maintain a local cache for performance, metrics, offline inspection, or dashboard generation. The cache shall not silently override authoritative backend state.

requirementTraceRows.title: Configuration Model
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe Core shall define configuration for projects, backend adapters, actor policies, workflow rules, protected paths, verification commands, and cross-project delegations.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human-Only Operation Enforcement

requirementTraceRows.title: Sensitive Operation Policy

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Trail Integrity

requirementTraceRows.title: Dry-Run Mode

requirementTraceRows.title: Canonical Repo-Local Store
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall maintain canonical workflow state in a repo-local structured store.

Rationale: workflow state must move with the source code across branches, forks, checkouts, and reverts.

requirementTraceRows.title: Stable Work Item Identity
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall assign stable IDs to Epics, Sprints, Tasks, Issues, Requirements, Evidence records, and Trace records.

requirementTraceRows.title: Relationship Model
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall represent relationships between work products by ID, including:

- Epic to Sprint.
- Epic to Task.
- Epic to Issue.
- Sprint to Task.
- Sprint to Issue.
- Requirement to Task.
- Requirement to Test.
- Requirement to Evidence.
- Task or Issue to Evidence.
- Work item to GitHub issue where applicable.

requirementTraceRows.title: Workflow Policy Authority
requirementTraceRows.statement: AirframeCore shall own workflow status definitions, allowed transitions, preconditions, and authority checks.

requirementTraceRows.title: Markdown Projection
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support generating human-readable Markdown documentation from canonical records.

Markdown projections shall not be the sole source of workflow truth.

requirementTraceRows.title: Validation Diagnostics
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AirframeCore shall detect inconsistent workflow state and report diagnostics with:

- Severity.
- Affected IDs.
- Reason code.
- Explanation.
- Recommended repair options.
- Required authority for repair.

requirementTraceRows.title: Repair Preview
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support previewing proposed repair actions before applying them.

requirementTraceRows.title: Audit Events
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall record audit events for canonical state mutations, including actor, operation, affected IDs, before state, after state, and authority decision.

requirementTraceRows.title: Test Evidence Summary
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support recording summarized test evidence without storing every raw local test run.

At minimum, test evidence shall include:

- Command or test source.
- Pass/fail summary.
- Relevant failing tests when applicable.
- Timestamp.
- Environment summary.
- Linked requirement IDs when applicable.
- Optional CI run or artifact link.

requirementTraceRows.title: CI Evidence Link
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support linking verification evidence to CI runs or CI artifacts when CI is configured.

CI evidence shall supplement, not replace, AirframeCore requirement verification policy.

requirementTraceRows.title: Requirement Traceability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support traceability between requirements, implementation work, tests, evidence, and release decisions.

requirementTraceRows.title: Fluid Requirements
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support requirement changes during development, including created, revised, superseded, deferred, waived, and removed requirement states.

requirementTraceRows.title: External Import Export Stubs
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall reserve interfaces for importing and exporting requirements from external tools.

Version 1.0 shall prioritize diffable local formats such as CSV and JSON. DOORS integration shall remain out of scope for Version 1.0 but shall not be precluded by the data model.

requirementTraceRows.title: Release Candidate Gate
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support release candidate close criteria based on workflow state, requirement traceability, verification evidence, validation approval, deviations, and blocking Issues.

requirementTraceRows.title: Generated Compliance Outputs
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support generating compliance and traceability documents from canonical records when templates are available.

Candidate outputs include:

- Compliance Verification Matrix.
- Requirements Traceability Matrix.
- Bidirectional Requirements Traceability Matrix.
- Deviation or waiver report.
- Test plan.
- Verification report.
- Release candidate closeout package.

## 4. Non-Functional Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Diffability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Canonical local state should be reasonably diffable in Git.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human Inspectability
requirementTraceRows.statement: Canonical state should be inspectable by humans using common repository tools.

requirementTraceRows.title: Deterministic Projection
requirementTraceRows.statement: Generated documentation should be deterministic to avoid noisy diffs.

requirementTraceRows.title: Backward Compatibility
requirementTraceRows.statement: Existing Markdown artifacts shall remain importable during migration.

requirementTraceRows.title: Authority Preservation
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Human-only verification, Sprint closure, Epic closure, release closeout, destructive repair, and policy mutation shall remain protected by AirframeCore authority evaluation.

## 5. Version 1.0 Boundary

Version 1.0 should include:

- Canonical repo-local state model.
- Basic requirement records.
- Requirement-to-work and requirement-to-test trace links.
- Summary test evidence.
- CI evidence link fields.
- CSV and JSON requirement import/export.
- Generated Markdown projections.
- Data health diagnostics.
- Initial AgileCockpit release gate visibility.

Version 1.0 should not include:

- Native DOORS integration.
- Full enterprise requirements management.
- Full document-template authoring.
- Server-based synchronization.
- Mandated code comments for every requirement.

requirementTraceRows.title: Requirement Records
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall maintain canonical requirement records with stable IDs.

requirementTraceRows.title: Requirement Revision State
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support requirement revision metadata, including status, source, version, rationale, and change history.

requirementTraceRows.title: Fluid Requirement Lifecycle
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support requirement lifecycle states suitable for active development, including:

- Proposed.
- Draft.
- Active.
- Implemented.
- Verified.
- Validated.
- Deferred.
- Waived.
- Superseded.
- Removed.

requirementTraceRows.title: Requirement Source
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall record whether a requirement was authored in Airframe, imported from a file, imported from an external tool, generated from another artifact, or manually entered.

requirementTraceRows.title: Implementation Trace
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support linking requirements to Tasks, Issues, Epics, Sprints, design records, source references, and commits where available.

requirementTraceRows.title: Verification Trace
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support linking requirements to test cases, test results, manual verification records, CI runs, and evidence artifacts.

requirementTraceRows.title: Validation Trace
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support linking requirements to human validation decisions and stakeholder approval evidence.

requirementTraceRows.title: Bidirectional Traceability
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support queries in both directions:

- From a requirement to implementing work, tests, evidence, and code references.
- From work, tests, evidence, and code references back to requirements.

requirementTraceRows.title: Traceability Gap Detection
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AirframeCore shall detect missing or incomplete traceability for in-scope requirements.

Example gaps:

- Requirement has no implementing work.
- Requirement has no verification method.
- Requirement has no passing verification evidence.
- Requirement has verification evidence but no validation decision where validation is required.
- Source reference claims a requirement that does not exist.

requirementTraceRows.title: Release Scope
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support defining which requirements are in scope for a release candidate.

requirementTraceRows.title: Release Gate Summary
requirementTraceRows.statement:
AgileCockpit shall show release candidate close criteria, including:

- In-scope requirements count.
- Implemented requirements count.
- Verified requirements count.
- Validated requirements count.
- Deferred or waived requirements count.
- Open deviations.
- Blocking traceability gaps.
- Blocking Issues.
- Missing test evidence.
- Missing human approvals.

requirementTraceRows.title: Deviation And Waiver Records
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support deviation and waiver records linked to affected requirements, rationale, authority, release scope, and expiration or review conditions.

requirementTraceRows.title: Test Result Summaries
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support storing summarized test result records that link to requirements.

Raw test logs may be external artifacts or CI artifacts and do not need to be committed to the repository.

requirementTraceRows.title: CI Integration Link
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support optional CI links for test results, coverage results, build results, and release candidate evidence.

requirementTraceRows.title: Code Reference Trace
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support optional code-level trace references to requirements.

Supported references may include:

- Source comments.
- Test names.
- Test metadata.
- Work item records.
- Commit metadata.
- Generated source scans.

Airframe shall not require every requirement to be referenced directly in code comments unless project policy requires it.

requirementTraceRows.title: Compliance Document Generation
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall support generating traceability and compliance documents from canonical records and templates.

Initial document targets:

- Compliance Verification Matrix.
- Requirements Traceability Matrix.
- Bidirectional Requirements Traceability Matrix.
- Deviation or waiver report.
- Test plan.
- Verification report.
- Release candidate closeout report.

## 4. Import Export Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: CSV Import
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support importing requirements from CSV.

requirementTraceRows.title: CSV Export
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support exporting requirements and traceability summaries to CSV.

requirementTraceRows.title: JSON Import Export
requirementTraceRows.statement: Airframe shall support importing and exporting canonical requirement records as JSON.

requirementTraceRows.title: Diffable Workflow
requirementTraceRows.statement: Requirement import/export files shall support review through Git diffs where practical.

requirementTraceRows.title: External Tool Stubs
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Airframe shall reserve import/export adapter boundaries for external requirements tools such as DOORS.

Native DOORS integration is out of scope for Version 1.0.

## 5. Release Gate Requirements

requirementTraceRows.title: Configurable Gate Policy
requirementTraceRows.statement: AirframeCore shall support configurable release gate policy.

requirementTraceRows.title: Default Gate Policy
requirementTraceRows.statement:
The default release candidate gate shall require:

- No blocking Issues.
- All in-scope requirements are implemented, deferred, waived, or explicitly out of scope.
- All in-scope non-deferred requirements have required verification evidence.
- All requirements requiring validation have validation approval.
- All deviations and waivers have approving authority.
- No blocking traceability diagnostics remain.

requirementTraceRows.title: Gate Explanation
requirementTraceRows.statement: AirframeCore shall explain why a release candidate can or cannot close.

requirementTraceRows.title: Human Authority
requirementTraceRows.statement:
Final release candidate closeout and validation approval shall require human authority.

## 6. Version 1.0 Boundary

Version 1.0 should provide a lightweight traceability foundation:

- Requirement records.
- CSV/JSON import/export.
- Requirement-to-work trace links.
- Requirement-to-test trace links.
- Test evidence summaries.
- Release gate summary.
- Generated traceability reports from simple templates.

Version 1.0 should avoid:

- Full DOORS replacement behavior.
- Deep external requirements-tool synchronization.
- Mandatory source-code annotation for all requirements.
- Heavy template authoring workflows.
